scalars.scalar_value: EDUCATION: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree as required for Athletic Trainer certification; hold and maintain a current Athletic Trainer (ATC) and Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) certificates as required by the Board of Certification (BOC) for the Athletic Trainer . Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment. ( Experience Requirement : One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units.) Education must be from an accredited institution.

items.item_text: 01. Please indicate how you meet the certification qualifications for the Athletic Trainer position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. NOTE: Certifacte information must be clearly stated in the Certificates and Licenses section of the application. Missing information may result in the experience not being counted. Options: I hold current Athletic Trainer (ATC) and Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) certificates. | I ONLY hold a current Athletic Trainer (ATC) certificate. | I ONLY hold a current Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) certificate. | I do not have either certifications.

02. Please indicate how you meet the minimum qualifications for the Athletic Trainer position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. Options: I have a Bachelor's or Master’s degree as required for Athletic Trainer certification AND two years of experience as a Certified Athletic Trainer. | I do not meet minimum qualifications.
EXPERIENCE: Two years of experience as a Certified Athletic Trainer.
